query.sql:
SELECT q.doc_version, q.ran_at, q.chunk_count, q.empty_rate,
       q.dup_rate, q.lesson_order_ok, q.conclusion
FROM qc_reports q
JOIN (SELECT doc_version, MAX(ran_at) AS latest FROM qc_reports GROUP BY doc_version) t
  ON q.doc_version = t.doc_version AND q.ran_at = t.latest
ORDER BY q.doc_version
